orders.title: Raise variable-less using(expr) when the resource local is disposed-only
orders.brief: Elide the resource variable to the variable-less using(expr) form only when the resource slot is referenced solely by the generated Dispose machinery; keep using(T v = ...) when the body reads it (close negative + non-vacuity). Reuse witness CfgSampleClass.InlineArraySpanUsingResource read-only; put the body-referenced close-negative in the new DisposedOnlyUsingFixture. Prove the folded form recompiles to identical IL. Exercise Markdown and structured render modes. Land the Full-fidelity-vs-fully-raised docs note (quality/taste/pr-template) in the same change.

orders.title: Opt-in taste lens folding conv.i8 of an int constant to an NL long literal
orders.brief: Add an opt-in (not default) taste lens that folds Convert(->Int64, Int32 constant) into a single NL long literal, reusing the UL/NL suffix path in CSharpPrinter.Numerics.cs. Fold ONLY when the source IL was ldc.i4(.s) N; conv.i8; preserve (long)N when the source opcode was a genuine ldc.i8 (opcode-fidelity guard, close negative). Register the lens in StyleOptionCatalog as byte-divergent/opt-in. Compile-back verify the folded output round-trips. Reuse witness CfgSampleClass.InlineArraySpanTernaryConditionValue read-only.
